gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Noto Sans Avestan keeps its curves apart, tips never touching, and its tall x-height gives text plenty of presence. Noto Sans Avestan's real strength is how modern it feels beside Mystery Quest's bookish, nostalgic display lettering.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Noto Sans Bassa Vah reads with a huge midsection that swallows the line's height, its c gaping like pliers. Mystery Quest above it stays compact, so the two feel distinct.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Noto Sans Grantha packs tall little letters, like flattened pen-nib bowls, and never snags on a closed-up bowl in the line. Mystery Quest earns its keep big and short.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Mystery Quest brings bookish, nostalgic display charm, with open jaws on every curve and compact ascenders above its tall lowercase. And Noto Sans Hebrew does the quiet work, its huge midsection and wide curve gaps carrying the text.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-hk: Open jaws on every curve give Mystery Quest a bookish, nostalgic face before you read a word of it. Noto Sans HK follows with large lowercase and lifted brush ends, so a long passage moves along smoothly.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-imperial-: Pincers and bookish nostalgia: Mystery Quest opens every curve while Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic points its c ends apart in a friendly way. The approachable body is the strongest thing here.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-inscripti: Big, open eyes and a deep middle band. Mystery Quest brings bookish, nostalgic jaws and compact ascenders over Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian, whose wide letterforms keep the text easy going underneath.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-jp: Noto Sans JP reads tall and open, its curves sweeping wide instead of curling shut, with a very tall x-height. Shrink Mystery Quest and it loses its charm.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Lowercase that fills the line like capitals. Mystery Quest does bookish, nostalgic display best, with open-jawed curves, while Noto Sans Kaithi does the plain work of an open e channel and a contemporary, neutral read.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Noto Sans Kannada keeps a gentle bump from small letters up to capitals, and its s curves open wide at both ends. Mystery Quest adds a bookish, nostalgic lead above.
